summary: Contactless locker drop for equipment return + temporary QR badge provisioning for employee cross-site relocation
description:
Issue summary: Employee is relocating from Redwood HQ (us-west campus) to the satellite office in Austin and needs a contactless process for returning legacy hardware plus a temporary QR badge for site access during the move. Impact: Delayed returns will block inventory reconciliation and delay decommissioning of sensitive dongles. Employee cannot access the receiving desk in Austin without a temporary credential, so courier handoffs need coordination.

Requested outcome: Schedule a contactless locker drop at HQ for the employee to deposit three assets (1x MacBook Pro asset tag RB-83421, 1x USB security dongle RB-SEC-109, 1x external monitor RB-MON-442). Generate a pre-paid courier pickup from the locker to central warehouse and provision a time-bound QR badge (48 hours) for the employee to collect replacement peripherals at the Austin office. Provide tracking numbers and confirmation to employee and mobile contact.

Links: Slack thread #facilities (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02FACILITIES/p1650001234000300), Confluence runbook: Lockerized-Returns (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/FAC/Lockerized+Returns).
location: HQ campus - Loading Dock C, Locker Bay 7
actions_needed: 1) Reserve Locker Bay 7 for contactless return window: Mar 12 09:00-17:00 PST. 2) Create and print contactless deposit QR code sheet and place in employee mail slot. 3) Provision temporary QR badge (valid 2026-03-12 08:00 to 2026-03-14 08:00) scoped to building access and receiving area only. 4) Schedule courier pickup (FedEx account XXXXXXXXX) for Mar 13 10:00 local pickup and route to Central Warehouse - Asset Intake. 5) Update asset inventory and close chain-of-custody ticket when scanned at warehouse.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - operational task. Included here: 1) Confirm employee identity (photo ID) via Slack DM and HR relocation note. 2) Create locker reservation in Facilities calendar. 3) Drop QR sheet in employee slot. 4) Employee deposits assets and scans deposit QR. 5) Courier collects from locker and confirms pickup via tracking URL.
